features: Local Taste Engine: Offline, account-free algorithmic recommendation engine with skip tracking and taste mix generation
Local Taste Engine (Slice 2): Multi-source Last.fm recommendation pipeline (similar tracks, similar artists, top genres) with 1-hour taste snapshot caching and additive scoring bonuses
Local Taste Engine (Slice 3): Genre awareness with additive scoring bonus (+1.0), YouTube taste signals extraction, cross-screen generation status synchronization, and 'From Taste' quick action
